get_built_tool_path(
  TOOL_enum_parser_bin
  TOOL_enum_parser_dependency
  tools/enum_parser/enum_parser
  enum_parser
)

add_library(catboost-cuda-data)

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  if(${CMAKE_VERSION} VERSION_LESS "3.17.0")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Build with HIP requires at least cmake 3.17.0")
  endif()

  enable_language(HIP)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -D__HIP_PLATFORM_AMD__")


  find_package(HIP REQUIRED)
  target_include_directories(catboost-cuda-data PRIVATE ${HIP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()

target_link_libraries(catboost-cuda-data PUBLIC
  contrib-libs-linux-headers
  contrib-libs-cxxsupp
  yutil
  catboost-cuda-cuda_lib
  private-libs-ctr_description
  catboost-libs-data
  private-libs-data_types
  catboost-libs-model
  catboost-libs-helpers
  private-libs-options
  private-libs-feature_estimator
  tools-enum_parser-enum_serialization_runtime
)

target_sources(catboost-cuda-data PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/catboost/cuda/data/feature.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/catboost/cuda/data/binarizations_manager.cpp
